en.html:
My <ruby>speed<rt>legs</rt></ruby> would not rise.
My <ruby>turning<rt>hips</rt></ruby> would not answer.

The last exchange... Had I driven this unfit body into that fierce attack, and now—!
Now, when it mattered most............no heat!!

Could this have been the enemy's plan?
Had it been keeping its trump card back, to shoot me down once I was exhausted!?

What a failure!
